lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਤੁਲਿ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਉਪਮਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥੮॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam tul aur na upamaa jan naanak kripaa kareejai ||8||1||
lines.translation: Nothing else can equal the Glory of the Lord's Name; please bless servant Nanak with Your Grace. ||8||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸੁ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam gur paaras paras kareejai ||
lines.translation: O Lord, please bless me with the Touch of the Guru, the Philosopher's Stone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੀ ਮਨੂਰ ਅਤਿ ਫੀਕੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham niragunee manoor at pheeke mil satigur paaras keejai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I was unworthy, utterly useless, rusty slag; meeting with the True Guru, I was transformed by the Philosopher's Stone. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਗ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਸਭਿ ਬਾਂਛਹਿ ਨਿਤਿ ਆਸਾ ਆਸ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: surag mukat baiku(n)th sabh baa(n)chhahi nit aasaa aas kareejai ||
lines.translation: Everyone longs for paradise, liberation and heaven; all place their hopes in them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਮਾਂਗਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har darasan ke jan mukat na maa(n)gahi mil darasan tripat man dheejai ||1||
lines.translation: The humble long for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; they do not ask for liberation. Their minds are satisfied and comforted by His Darshan. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਬਲੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਰੀ ਮੋਹੁ ਕਾਲਖ ਦਾਗ ਲਗੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa mohu sabal hai bhaaree mohu kaalakh daag lageejai ||
lines.translation: Emotional attachment to Maya is very powerful; this attachment is a black stain which sticks.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਅਲਿਪਤ ਹੈ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਜਿਉ ਮੁਰਗਾਈ ਪੰਕੁ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: mere thaakur ke jan alipat hai mukate jiu muragaaee pa(n)k na bheejai ||2||
lines.translation: The humble servants of my Lord and Master are unattached and liberated. They are like ducks, whose feathers do not get wet. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸੁ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਮ ਵੇੜੀ ਕਿਵ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: cha(n)dan vaas bhuia(n)gam veRee kiv mileeai cha(n)dan leejai ||
lines.translation: The fragrant sandalwood tree is encircled by snakes; how can anyone get to the sandalwood?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਢਿ ਖੜਗੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਕਰਾਰਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਛੇਦਿ ਛੇਦਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kaadh khaRag gur giaan karaaraa bikh chhed chhed ras peejai ||3||
lines.translation: Drawing out the Mighty Sword of the Guru's Spiritual Wisdom, I slaughter and kill the poisonous snakes, and drink in the Sweet Nectar. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨਿ ਆਨਿ ਸਮਧਾ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੀ ਪਲੁ ਬੈਸੰਤਰ ਭਸਮ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aan aan samadhaa bahu keenee pal baisa(n)tar bhasam kareejai ||
lines.translation: You may gather wood and stack it in a pile, but in an instant, fire reduces it to ashes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਉਗ੍ਰ ਪਾਪ ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਕੀਨੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਲੂਕੀ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa ugr paap saakat nar keene mil saadhoo lookee deejai ||4||
lines.translation: The faithless cynic gathers the most horrendous sins, but meeting with the Holy Saint, they are placed in the fire. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਰੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhoo saadh saadh jan neeke jin a(n)tar naam dhareejai ||
lines.translation: The Holy, Saintly devotees are sublime and exalted. They enshrine the Naam, the Name of the Lord, deep within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਸ ਨਿਪਰਸੁ ਭਏ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ਦਿਖੀਜੈ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: paras niparas bhae saadhoo jan jan har bhagavaan dikheejai ||5||
lines.translation: By the touch of the Holy and the humble servants of the Lord, the Lord God is seen. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਸੂਤੁ ਬਹੁ ਗੁਰਝੀ ਭਰਿਆ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਤਾਨੁ ਤਨੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saakat soot bahu gurajhee bhariaa kiu kar taan taneejai ||
lines.translation: The thread of the faithless cynic is totally knotted and tangled; how can anything be woven with it?

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੰਤੁ ਸੂਤੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਾਕਤ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: ta(n)t soot kichh nikasai naahee saakat sa(n)g na keejai ||6||
lines.translation: This thread cannot be woven into yarn; do not associate with those faithless cynics. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਨੀਕੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur saadhasa(n)gat hai neekee mil sa(n)gat raam raveejai ||
lines.translation: The True Guru and the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, are exalted and sublime. Joining the Congregation, meditate on the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਮਾਣਕ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar ratan javehar maanak gur kirapaa te leejai ||7||
lines.translation: The gems, jewels and precious stones are deep within; by Guru's Grace, they are found. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਵਡਾ ਵਡਾ ਹੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਹ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: meraa thaakur vadaa vadaa hai suaamee ham kiu kar milah mileejai ||
lines.translation: My Lord and Master is Glorious and Great. How can I be united in His Union?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੮॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak mel milaae gur pooraa jan kau pooran deejai ||8||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Perfect Guru unites His humble servant in His Union, and blesses him with perfection. ||8||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਾ ਰਮ ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: raamaa ram raamo raam raveejai ||
lines.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, the Lord, the All-pervading Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhoo saadh saadh jan neeke mil saadhoo har ra(n)g keejai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Holy, the humble and Holy, are noble and sublime. Meeting with the Holy, I joyfully love the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਹੈ ਜੇਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲਤ ਡੋਲ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh jag hai jetaa man dolat dol kareejai ||
lines.translation: The minds of all the beings and creatures of the world waver unsteadily.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਥੰਮਨ ਕਉ ਥੰਮੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kripaa kripaa kar saadh milaavahu jag tha(n)man kau tha(n)m deejai ||1||
lines.translation: Please take pity on them, be merciful to them, and unite them with the Holy; establish this support to support the world. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਸੁਧਾ ਤਲੈ ਤਲੈ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਰੁਲੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: basudhaa talai talai sabh oopar mil saadhoo charan ruleejai ||
lines.translation: The earth is beneath us, and yet its dust falls down on all; let yourself be covered by the dust of the feet of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਅਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਸਭ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਚਰਨ ਤਲ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: at ootam at ootam hovahu sabh sisat charan tal deejai ||2||
lines.translation: You shall be utterly exalted, the most noble and sublime of all; the whole world will place itself at your feet. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਭਲੀ ਸਿਵ ਨੀਕੀ ਆਨਿ ਪਾਨੀ ਸਕਤਿ ਭਰੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh jot bhalee siv neekee aan paanee sakat bhareejai ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs are blessed with the Divine Light of the Lord; Maya comes to serve them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈਨਦੰਤ ਨਿਕਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਸਾਰੁ ਚਬਿ ਚਬਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: mainada(n)t nikase gur bachanee saar chab chab har ras peejai ||3||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, they bite with teeth of wax and chew iron, drinking in the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਪੁਰਖ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam anugrahu bahu keeaa gur saadhoo purakh mileejai ||
lines.translation: The Lord has shown great mercy, and bestowed His Name; I have met with the Holy Guru, the Primal Being.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਸਥੀਰਨ ਕੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਜਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: gun raam naam bisatheeran keee har sagal bhavan jas deejai ||4||
lines.translation: The Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name have spread out everywhere; the Lord bestows fame all over the world. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhoo saadh saadh man preetam bin dekhe rahi na sakeejai ||
lines.translation: The Beloved Lord is within the minds of the Holy, the Holy Saadhus; without seeing Him, they cannot survive.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਜਲੰ ਜਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਫੂਟਿ ਮਰੀਜੈ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: jiu jal meen jala(n) jal preet hai khin jal bin phoot mareejai ||5||
lines.translation: The fish in the water loves only the water. Without water, it bursts and dies in an instant. ||5||
